text:
Alyssa: Quick poll — what's more likely to start an office feud: someone committing `version: 1.0` to YAML again, or someone converting two-space indents into tabs?
Diego: Tabs, every time. Tabs sneak in like ninjas.
Mina: semver + YAML combo is nuclear tbh. Found `version: v1.0.0` under a tabbed block yesterday and my brain died. :cry: 
Ethan: I vote Tabs. There's nothing like random `	` in a CI parser to ruin your morning.
Alyssa: Also, anyone have a succinct throwaway gif? I vote compiler screaming owl.
ops-bot: FYI: last PR with mixed whitespace triggered lint errors in 3 repos — see https://git.company/reports/whitespace-incident
Diego: is there a t-shirt of a compiler with sunglasses that says "I optimize my feelings"?
Mina: quick meme attached: https://i.imgur.com/compilermeme.png :joy: 
Alyssa: ok new rule: PR titles must include either `tabs-are-evil` or `semver-apocalypse` so we can triage faster.
Ethan: lol can we add :thumbsup: reactions as votes?
Mina: :thumbsup: 
Diego: :thumbsup: :thumbsup: 
Alyssa: Results: Tabs 3, Semver+YAML 1. We're doomed but consistent.
Ethan: also, note to self — if you must semver in YAML, use `version: "1.0.0"` with double quotes and pray.
Mina: or better: keep semver in package manifests, not in config blobs.
Alyssa: End poll. Winner: Tabs. Consequence: mandatory chocolate for anyone who pushes a tabbed YAML. :chocolate_bar:
